data.name: List.Description
data.value: Administer logical storage resources, their exact types and explicit connections.

data.name: Editor.Description
data.value: Select a versioned implementation and configure its governed logical envelope.

data.name: Details.Description
data.value: Inspect the saved identity, mappings, availability and dependent resources.

data.name: Empty.Description
data.value: Create a Storage in this context or adjust the filters.

data.name: TypeCatalog.Help
data.value: Capabilities describe the exact implementation version. A type does not create a connection or grant access.

data.name: NoTypes
data.value: No visible Storage type is available in this context.

data.name: Identity.Help
data.value: The selected administrative context owns this resource. Its scoped name and namespace remain fixed after creation.

data.name: SavedTypeUnavailable
data.value: The saved exact type is unavailable. Its reference is preserved. Explicitly select an available version to reconcile.

data.name: LimitsValue
data.value: Page: {0} items · Read: {1} bytes · Write: {2} bytes

data.name: ManualMapping.Help
data.value: Choose each compatible export yourself. No mapping is selected automatically. Connection values remain owned by Connected Services.

data.name: SavedServiceUnavailable
data.value: Saved service revision unavailable — choose explicitly to rebind

data.name: Service.Help
data.value: Only enabled, ready services are offered. The API verifies authorization and use policy at save time. No credentials are read here.

data.name: SavedExportUnavailable
data.value: Saved export is stale or incompatible

data.name: LocalStorage
data.value: This Storage has no Connected Service.

data.name: Envelope.Help
data.value: The envelope fixes the logical authority of this Storage. Consumers cannot override its type, connection or envelope.

data.name: Dependents.Help
data.value: Deactivation preserves the resource and retained history. The API refuses unsafe changes while dependencies exist.

data.name: NoDependents
data.value: No dependencies reported by the API.

data.name: Yaml.Help
data.value: Read-only resource definition. It contains references and Storage configuration, never resolved connection secrets.

data.name: ReadOnlyHelp
data.value: To edit this resource, select its owner context with resource write permission. Managed resources remain under their owner’s authority.

data.name: Reconcile.Confirm
data.value: Observe availability and drift using the saved exact references? This does not replace any binding or invoke storage operations.

data.name: Rebind.Confirm
data.value: Apply this complete configuration and its explicit mappings? The API will verify dependencies, permissions and exact revisions before accepting the change. Retained history is preserved.

data.name: Deactivate.Confirm
data.value: Deactivate this logical Storage? The API checks dependencies first. The resource and retained history will remain.

data.name: Validation.Required
data.value: Enter a display name and a valid lowercase resource name. Select a type and explicitly bind every required export. Correct the schema validation errors before saving.

data.name: Error.RefreshHelp
data.value: Refresh to inspect current references and permissions. Review the definition and confirm changes explicitly.

data.name: Error.Conflict
data.value: This revision is stale. Refresh before editing again; your changes were not applied.

data.name: Error.Mapping
data.value: Complete the required mappings using exports with compatible types and protection.

data.name: Error.Export
data.value: An export is missing or stale. Inspect the service and explicitly select current exports before reconciling.

data.name: Error.ServiceStale
data.value: The Connected Service UID or generation changed. Review the new service and explicitly rebind it.

data.name: Error.Service
data.value: The Connected Service is disabled, incompatible or unavailable. Inspect it before retrying.

data.name: Error.Drift
data.value: The saved type or bindings drifted. Review the exact version and confirm reconciliation in Definition.

data.name: Error.Provider
data.value: The implementation provider is unavailable. The resource and its history are preserved. Restore the provider or explicitly select an available implementation.

data.name: Error.Configuration
data.value: The configuration is invalid. Check the selected schema, configuration and logical envelope.

data.name: Error.InUse
data.value: Dependencies prevent this change. Inspect dependent resources and their retention rules.

data.name: Error.Forbidden
data.value: Access is denied in this context. Select an authorized context and verify resource use permissions.

data.name: Error.NotFound
data.value: This exact resource is no longer visible. Return to the catalog and check its scope and namespace.

data.name: Error.Generic
data.value: The Storage request failed. Refresh and retry after checking service availability.

data.name: Type.ListHelp
data.value: Administer implementation contracts, immutable versions and scoped resource grants.

data.name: Type.ImmutableHelp
data.value: Published versions cannot be changed or removed. Publish a new version to change schemas, requirements or capabilities. Existing Storages keep their exact selected version.

data.name: Type.RequirementsHelp
data.value: Enter a JSON array of requirement descriptors: id, required, type, protection and optional format. Use [] when no Connected Service is required. Credentials remain Secret references on the Connected Service.

data.name: Type.CapabilitiesHelp
data.value: Declare only operations actually implemented by this version. Capabilities describe support; they do not grant user permissions or resource access.

data.name: Type.SetPreferred
data.value: Make this the preferred version for new selections

data.name: Type.Validation
data.value: Enter valid, bounded JSON schemas and a requirements array. Review the version, metadata and limits before saving.

data.name: Type.ReviewCurrent
data.value: Review current saved revision without discarding my draft

data.name: Type.CurrentSaved
data.value: Current saved display name: {0}. Generation: {1}. Your draft is retained; review it before saving again.

data.name: Type.ManagedHelp
data.value: Core or the contributing extension owns this definition and lifecycle. Permitted resource grants are administered separately in Access.

data.name: Type.UsagesHelp
data.value: Only references discoverable in your current context are listed (up to 100). Other dependencies may still prevent disablement or deletion.

data.name: Type.AccessHelp
data.value: These are resource-scope Discover/Use grants, separate from user roles and implementation capabilities. A saved Use grant alone does not guarantee functional use: existing UsePolicy, enablement, provider availability and exact references still apply. UsePolicy administration is deferred.

data.name: Type.DeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete this user-owned Storage type? Published contracts and references must be reviewed first. Any Storage dependency will prevent deletion.

data.name: Error.TypeInUse
data.value: A Storage references this type. Review its dependencies before disabling or deleting it.

data.name: Error.TypeImmutable
data.value: This version is already published and immutable. Publish a different version instead.

data.name: Error.TypeManaged
data.value: This definition is managed by Core or an extension. Only permitted resource grants can be administered here.

data.name: Type.DisableConfirm
data.value: Disable this type for new use? All Storage references must be reviewed first. Referenced types cannot be disabled.
